Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a retrocardiac opacity with an air-fluid level (cystic lesion) and an adjacent soft tissue mass in the left paracardiac region, which is characteristic of a mixed-type hiatal hernia containing both stomach and other abdominal contents. Option B correctly describes the smooth margin of the cystic component (gas-filled stomach) and the extension of the mass from the mediastinum to the left paracardiac area.
